dialogues.dialogue: In this world, there exists humans and the robots that serve them. With today's advanced technology, robots are able to attend to all the needs a human may have.
Robots can be housmaids, firefighters, doctors... the possiblities are endless! However, all robots have Three Laws they must abide by.
First, a robot shall never injure a human being or allow a human being to come to harm;
Second, unless they conflict with the First Law, a robot must obey their human's orders;
And finally, so long as there is no conflict with the First or Second Law, a robot must protect its own existence.
The Three Laws? Of course, I know those. I'm a mechanic, after all. But... why...?
